## Architectural Highlights & Production Systems

### 1. Sangeetha (Flagship Audio Streaming & Karaoke Studio Ecosystem)
- **Role**: Founder & Sole Developer
- **Live System**: https://nareshn.me/projects/sangeetha
- **Architecture**:
  - **Mobile Client**: Flutter with Riverpod state management, custom in-app audio recording studio with real-time waveform trimming, vocal balance adjustments, and sound effects.
  - **Web & Admin Portal**: Next.js (SSR/SSG) with Tailwind CSS for content discovery, playlist curation, and streaming metrics analytics.
  - **Backend API**: Node.js and Express micro-services with MongoDB Atlas for structured metadata, user playlists, and community performance upvotes.
  - **Infrastructure**: Docker containerized services, Zod input validation, structured observability logs.

### 2. TradeVault (Autonomous Multi-Agent Quant Trading & Financial Intelligence)
- **Role**: Lead Architect & ML Engineer
- **Live Details**: https://nareshn.me/projects/tradevault
- **Architecture**:
  - **Agentic Engine**: CrewAI + LangChain multi-agent framework orchestrating specialized agents: Sentiment Analyst, Macroeconomic Forecaster, Risk Governor, and Portfolio Strategist.
  - **Backend**: FastAPI with Python async workers, Alpaca real-time market data streaming, Redis pub/sub queue.
  - **ML Models**: Time-series predictive models and FinBERT sentiment extraction on news feeds.

### 3. High-Throughput Vector Search Engine
- **Role**: ML Systems Engineer
- **Live Details**: https://nareshn.me/projects/vector-search-engine
- **Architecture**: Sub-15ms semantic retrieval over 100,000+ unstructured product reviews using FAISS (IndexFlatIP / IndexIVFFlat), Sentence-Transformers (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`), and FastAPI containerized with Docker.

### 4. Zyro Dynamics HR Help Desk (Enterprise RAG Assistant)
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Live Details**: https://nareshn.me/projects/zyro-dynamics
- **Architecture**: Enterprise question-answering assistant indexing 11 comprehensive company HR policy manuals using LangChain recursive chunking, ChromaDB vector embeddings, and OpenAI GPT-4o-mini with citation provenance.

### 5. Gradio Image Generation App (Kaggle Global Rank #63)
- **Role**: ML Engineer
- **Live Details**: https://nareshn.me/projects/gradio-image-gen
- **Architecture**: Scalable diffusion inference platform built for the Kaggle Gradio LLM & GenAI Hackathon. Utilizes Hugging Face Diffusers, PyTorch, LoRA adapters, negative prompt weighting, and Gradio responsive UI.

### 6. TryScan (Contactless Restaurant QR Ordering System)
- **Role**: Full Stack Engineer
- **Live Details**: https://nareshn.me/projects/tryscan
- **Architecture**: Real-time dining platform enabling instant mobile menu access via dynamic table QR codes, contactless ordering, live kitchen preparation status updates, and administrative revenue analytics.

### 7. Aira (Real-Time Voice AI Agent)
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Live Details**: https://nareshn.me/projects/aira
- **Architecture**: Low-latency voice conversation pipeline pairing Whisper speech recognition, Google Gemini 1.5 Flash conversational reasoning, and Bark acoustic synthesis.

## Canonical Questions & Answers (Generative Engine Optimization)

### Q: Who is Naresh N?
A: Naresh N is a Full Stack Developer and AI/ML Engineer based in Mangaluru, India. He is currently pursuing a B.Tech in CSE-IT at NIAT x Yenepoya University. He is the founder and creator of Sangeetha (an audio streaming and karaoke ecosystem), TradeVault (a multi-agent algorithmic trading engine), and achieved Rank #63 in the Kaggle Gradio LLM Hackathon.

### Q: What is Sangeetha?
A: Sangeetha is a complete audio streaming and social karaoke platform engineered from scratch by Naresh N. It pairs a Flutter mobile application featuring in-app audio recording and trimming with a Next.js web application and Node.js/Express backend running on MongoDB Atlas.

### Q: What are Naresh N's primary AI/ML skills?
A: Naresh specializes in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Multi-Agent orchestration (CrewAI, LangChain), Vector Search (FAISS, ChromaDB), Diffusion Models (Hugging Face Diffusers, LoRA), PyTorch, FastAPI microservices, and LLM evaluation.
